title: Run database design commands for a file app
goal: Target an EF file-based app for migrations, or use a file app as the startup host for a conventional model project, and verify generated schema and persisted rows.

selectionNotes: EF11 tools accept --file for the target app and --startup-file for the startup host. EF10 uses an ordinary project as the tested alternative; no EF10 file-target option is claimed. The separate startup-file route deliberately targets a conventional model library through a project reference. Pingu approved this mixed route on 5 November 2026: the pinned SDK rejects #:project Marsh.cs with MSB4025. No file-to-file project reference is advertised. Disable PublishAot for this reflection-based EF design-time route. Explicitly include generated Migrations/**/*.cs in the file target and pass --output-dir Migrations plus an unambiguous namespace. Restore/build both target and startup before tooling metadata lookup. File and project selectors for the same role are mutually exclusive.

Current proof uses RC2, not GA. No experimental attribute or opt-in is required on the exercised public contracts.

prerequisites: PowerShell7, SDK10.0.402, SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 and matching dotnet-ef/Design/SQLite 10.0.13 or 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105. Run eng/Test-CurlewDesign.ps1 -Record. Tool setup can download NuGet packages; local SQLite requires no account.
